descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
BoomBox is back!!!
Remastered. Remixed. Reborn with soul and a heartbeat you can feel through your controllers. 

No more modding. No setup. Everything is already here.

BoomBox lets you drum, move, and turn your energy into rhythm inside vibrant worlds that react to every beat.
[media]

**🎶 All Community Maps. Built Right In. 🎶**

Every custom song, every map, every wild idea lives inside the game.
Browse, download, and play instantly.

No mods. No file hunting. No barriers.
[media]

**Fitness. Dancing. Flow!**

Train, chase perfect combos, or move with the music your way.
From fitness sessions to full-on dance runs, BoomBox adapts to how you play.
[media]

You’re not just playing. You’re part of it.

**Key Features**

**🎵 150+ Maps & Growing**: All community-made maps available directly in-game. No mods. Ever.

**🥁 Drumming Gameplay**: Grab your sticks and hit with power, precision, and flow.

**🏆 Achievements & Unlockables**: Earn skins, rewards, and milestones as you play.

**✨ Reactive Worlds**: Check out our vibrant environments that move with the music.

**💪 Fitness That Works**: Maps built for movement, rhythm, and progression.

**🕺 Dance & Flow Gameplay**: Not just rhythm, full-body movement and expression.

**🎨 Create in One Click**: Build and share your own maps easily.

**👥 Community-Driven**: Every update shaped by real players.

**😻 Pupa is Back**: Your companion. Yes, you can pet her.
